length.sourceNote: From the Wikipedia infobox, uncited there (32.3 in).

barrelLength.sourceNote: From the Wikipedia infobox, uncited there (11 in).

cyclicRate.sourceNote: Wikipedia's article body states a single figure of 700 rounds/min, uncited; the same article's infobox instead gives an uncited range of 700 to 1000 rounds/min. Neither is a clickable primary source.

capacity.sourceNote: From Wikipedia's article body, uncited there: a 20-round magazine designed by John E. Owsley; two were often welded face-to-face for a fast reload. The infobox separately states a 25-round figure, which the body text attributes instead to the unproduced .45 ACP prototype.
